dz: 美国独立战争：魁北克战役：盖伊·卡尔顿将军领导下的英国军队在暴风雪中击退了大陆军将军理查德·蒙哥马利的进攻。

te: Arthur Guinness signs a 9,000-year lease at £45 per annum and starts brewing Guinness.
dz: 亚瑟·吉尼斯(Arthur Guinness)以每年45英镑的价格签下9000年的租约并开始酿造吉尼斯.

t: 俄国女王伊丽莎白一世发布她的卡塞 将克尼格斯贝格并入俄罗斯.
te: Empress Elizabeth I of Russia issues her ukase incorporating Königsberg into Russia.
dz: 俄国女王伊丽莎白一世发布她的卡塞 将克尼格斯贝格并入俄罗斯.

te: The first Huguenots set sail from France to the Cape of Good Hope.
dz: 第一艘胡格诺茨从法国起航去往好望角.
de: The first Huguenots set sail from France to the Cape of Good Hope.

dz: 约翰·纳伯勒(John Narborough)的探险队从科拉尔湾出发,在勘测了海岸后被西班牙人所损失了4名人质.
de: The expedition of John Narborough leaves Corral Bay, having surveyed the coast and lost four hostages to the Spanish.

dz: 詹姆斯,约克公爵被法国路易十四封为诺曼底公爵.
de: James, Duke of York is named Duke of Normandy by Louis XIV of France.

dz: 英国东印度公司被包租.

dz: 征服者,阿拉贡国王詹姆斯一世入驻麦地那·马尤尔卡(现为西班牙帕尔马·德·马略卡),从而完成了基督教对马略卡岛的重新征服.
de: James I the Conqueror, King of Aragon, enters Medina Mayurqa (now known as Palma de Mallorca, Spain), thus consummating the Christian reconquest of the island of Mallorca.

t: 越南的Lý王朝由男孩皇帝特伦·泰恩·通克(Trân Thái Tông)入宫而终结了216年,…
te: The Lý dynasty of Vietnam ends after 216 years by the enthronement of the boy emperor Trần Thái Tông, husband of the la…
dz: 越南的Lý王朝由男孩皇帝特伦·泰恩·通克(Trân Thái Tông)入宫而终结了216年,后者是最后一任Lý君主Lý Chiêu Hoàng的丈夫,开始了特伦王朝. [引用需要]
de: The Lý dynasty of Vietnam ends after 216 years by the enthronement of the boy emperor Trần Thái Tông, husband of the last Lý monarch, Lý Chiêu Hoàng, starting the Trần dynasty.[citation needed]

t: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利四世在英格尔海姆被迫退位给他的儿子亨利五世。
te: Holy Roman Emperor Henry IV is forced to abdicate in favor of his son, Henry V, in Ingelheim.
dz: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利四世在英格尔海姆被迫退位给他的儿子亨利五世。
de: Holy Roman Emperor Henry IV is forced to abdicate in favor of his son, Henry V, in Ingelheim.

de: Battle of Englefield: The Vikings clash with ealdorman Æthelwulf of Berkshire. The invaders are driven back to Reading (East Anglia); many Danes are killed.

de: Byzantine general Belisarius completes the conquest of Sicily, defeating the Gothic garrison of Palermo (Panormos), and ending his consulship for the year.
